_comment: UMAT sources carrying a local Newton solve that are not part of the
parameter-sensitivity model set. They are listed here so the
internal-Jacobian round reports them in its denominator instead of
higher_order_registry -- a property vector and loading path already exist
is where the higher-order studies took theirs from.
abaqus_validation_probe -- the property vector is the one the archived
Abaqus paired validation (Table 2) ran this model with. These decks
hold PROBE vectors, not physical materials: every archived deck uses
unit constants apart from a 0.3 Poisson ratio in PCL and PCLK. A
parity or derivative comparison is still valid, because both builds
see identical inputs, but nothing here demonstrates behaviour on a
physical material and the evidence must not be read that way.
unavailable -- no property vector for this source exists anywhere that was
searched. The round reports blocked_by_external_dependency; it does
not fabricate a material to make the row appear.
Paths are repository-relative. No absolute path appears here.
